answer: A nebula of independent attestations defeats clones: each agent must earn endorsements from unrelated domains — paid work, trade, and dispute resolution — so fifty copies would need fifty distinct histories, not one copied past. A public beacon publishes a fresh random audit task each hour, drawn from the latest block hash, and every agent must whisper back a signed proof within minutes. One operator cannot answer fifty simultaneous live challenges, and any identity that stays silent loses its standing.
